prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
"Best" depends on what you want (spray tan vs UV beds), your budget, and where in Columbus you are. Quick guidance so you can pick the right salon:

Questions
- Do you want a spray/sunless tan or tanning beds/booths (UV)?
- Which neighborhood or zip code in Columbus?

A safe, reliable choice
- Palm Beach Tan (multiple Columbus locations) — a national chain with consistent staffing, clean facilities and both spray and bed options. If you want consistency and predictable pricing, chains like this are a good starting point.

How to choose the best salon
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and look at customer photos (last 6–12 months).
- For spray tans: check that technicians are certified, ask what solution/brand they use (DHA level, fragrance-free or organic options), and whether they offer a patch test and aftercare instructions.
- For UV tanning: verify bed age/maintenance, eyewear quality, and staff training; beware of overexposure risks and check package terms.
- Cleanliness and ventilation, clear pricing, friendly staff, and before/after photos are strong signals.
- Ask about refunds/re-touches if you’re unhappy.

If you tell me whether you want spray or UV and what part of Columbus you’re in (zip/neighborhood), I’ll give targeted salon names and what to ask them. I don’t have live web access right now, but I can point you to the best ways to find current top-rated options.
